 Purpose of the Commission: The purpose of the HEAR Commission is to advance and advocate
 for equity, access, diversity, social justice, safety, mutual appreciation, increased cultural
 competency, positive inter-group relations and respect for all members of the San Gabriel
 community (the “Purpose”).

   MINUTES OF TUESDAY, APRIL 26, 2022
  MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL
  HUMAN EQUITY, ACCESS, AND RELATIONS (HEAR) COMMISSION

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Jennings-Nuñez called the regular meeting of the HEAR Commission to order at 6:31 p.m.
on Tuesday, April 26, 2022, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
Gabriel, California, 91776.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Fitzsimmons.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present:  Michelle Brenhaug, Jacqueline Borja, Susan Fitzsimmons, Viki Goto,
  Jorge Herrera, Chasity Jennings-Nuñez, and Riaz (Rick) Khan*..

Commissioners Absent:  None.

ANNOUNCMENTS

Recreation Supervisor Matthew Morales-Stevens provided information for the public on how to
submit comments, and how to request meeting agendas. If you wish to address the HEAR
Commission, e-mail all public comments to HEARCommission@sgch.org.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

  Chair Jennings-Nuñez hearing no objections, the Agenda Order was approved.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

HEAR COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  APRIL 26, 2022
   3. ACTION ITEMS

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  A motion was made by Vice-Chair Goto and seconded by Commissioner
  Fitzsimmons to approve the minutes of the HEAR Commission Regular Meeting for
  March 22, 2022.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 7-0-0 as follows:
  Ayes: Brenhaug, Borja, Fitzsimmons, Goto, Herrera, Jennings-Nuñez, Khan
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None

  4. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  A. GUEST SPEAKER – ABDULLAH ZIKRIA, SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA AREA
  MANAGER

  Commissioner Khan introduced the guest speaker, Abdullah Zikria Southern
  California Area Manager for Islamic Circle of North America (ICNA) Relief.

  The Commission thanked Mr. Zikria for his presentation and providing information
  on the services ICNA Relief offer including medical assistance and their food pantry.
  They were also grateful for the information he shared about Ramadan and the
  Muslim faith. They inquired about volunteer opportunities.

  Public Comment: None

  *Note: Commissioner Khan left meeting at 7:10 p.m.

  B. COMMUNITY OUTREACH/ PUBLIC INFORMATION PLANNING

  Vice Chair Goto presented this item.

  The Commission considered ways to promote the survey to increase number of
  responses. They discussed incentivizing the survey with prizes, creating signage at
  community events, social media posts and asking schools to distribute survey
  information.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Fitzsimmons and seconded by
  Commissioner Herrera to set deadlines for survey feedback. The initial deadline is
  scheduled for June 30. The secondary deadline is August 2.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 6-0-0-1 as follows:

HEAR COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  APRIL 26, 2022
   Ayes: Brenhaug, Borja, Fitzsimmons, Goto, Herrera, Jennings-Nuñez
  Nays: None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Khan

  Public Comment: None

  C. DISCUSSION OF APPROVED 2022 ANNUAL WORKPLAN

  Supervisor Morales-Stevens presented the item.

  The Commission provided updates regarding the Implicit Bias Training that was
  held for city employees last month.

  They also formed a planning committee for the Mental Health Expo,
  Commissioners Borja and Khan volunteered to join and Commissioner Brenhaug
  will take the lead. The tentative dates are currently September 11 and 18. The
  Commission is deciding on a location for the event. Staff were instructed to look
  at available venue options.

  The Commission plans to have LA Metro as the next speaker for the May meeting.

  Before the meeting could proceed to the next agenda item, there were technical
  difficulties with on-line streaming.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  A motion was made by Commissioner Fitzsimmons and seconded by
  Commissioner Borja to adjourn the HEAR Commission Regular Meeting due to
  technical difficulties.

  Motion approved as presented by a vote of 5-1-0-1 as follows:
  Ayes: Brenhaug, Borja, Fitzsimmons, Goto, Herrera
  Nays: Jennings-Nuñez
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Khan

  Chair Jennings-Nuñez adjourned the meeting at 8:05 p.m.

  Next regular meeting is tentatively scheduled in person for Tuesday, May 24, 2022 at 6:30
  p.m.
